date_of_radiographic_response_assessment.description: Date when the overall radiographic response was assessed.

psa_baseline_definition.description: Specifies the timepoint convention used to define the baseline PSA value. Required to ensure reproducibility of PCWG3-based PSA response and progression calculations across institutions.

psa_baseline_date.description: Date on which the baseline PSA sample was collected, as defined by PSA_Baseline_Definition.

psa_response_category.description: Categorical PSA response based on predefined criteria (e.g., PCWG3: >=50% decline).

radiographic_response_criteria.description: Criteria used for assessing radiographic response.

psa_nadir_date.description: Date on which the PSA nadir was recorded.

psa_response_50_confirmed.description: Indicates whether a confirmed ≥50% decline in PSA from baseline was achieved at any point during therapy. Confirmation requires a second value at least 3 weeks later. Per PCWG3.

psa_response_50_date.description: Date on which the ≥50% PSA decline from baseline was first documented (not the confirmation date).

psa_best_response_percent.description: Minimum signed 100 × (PSA at assessment − baseline PSA) / baseline PSA over the declared window when best response means greatest decline. Negative is decline. Specify selection rule; omit if baseline is zero.

psa_early_rise_pre12w.description: Whether an early PSA rise was observed; this does not classify it as flare or exclude true progression.

psa_progression_pcwg3_documented.description: Indicates whether PSA progression per PCWG3 criteria has been documented: ≥25% increase AND ≥2 ng/mL above nadir (after prior decline), or ≥25% AND ≥2 ng/mL above baseline (no prior decline beyond 12 weeks), confirmed ≥3 weeks later.

psa_progression_pcwg3_date.description: Date of first PSA value meeting PCWG3 progression criteria (not the confirmation date). Per PCWG3, this date does not necessarily indicate clinical need to discontinue therapy.

psa_progression_pcwg3_confirmed_date.description: Date of the confirmatory PSA value (≥3 weeks after PSA_Progression_PCWG3_Date) establishing definitive PCWG3 PSA progression.

psa_progression_criteria_used.description: Specifies the PSA progression criteria applied, to enable harmonization across datasets with different conventions.

imaging_response_criteria_used.description: Specifies the imaging response/progression criteria applied for this patient or study.

imaging_overall_response.description: Overall radiographic response assessment across all sites at best response timepoint.

imaging_overall_response_date.description: Date on which the overall radiographic response assessment was performed.

imaging_progression_type.description: Characterizes the nature of radiographic progression per PCWG3, distinguishing growth of pre-existing lesions from development of new lesions, as these carry distinct prognostic and biological implications.

imaging_progression_site.description: Anatomical site(s) at which radiographic progression was first documented, recorded separately per site per PCWG3.

imaging_progression_date.description: Date of first documented radiographic progression at any site (earliest site-specific progression date).

soft_tissue_response_recist.description: Best overall response in measurable soft tissue disease (nodal and/or visceral) per RECIST 1.1, recorded separately from bone disease per PCWG3.

nodal_progression_pcwg3.description: Indicates whether nodal progression per PCWG3 criteria has been documented. Previously normal nodes (<1.0 cm) must have grown ≥5 mm in short axis AND be ≥1.0 cm in short axis. For existing pathologic nodes (≥1.5 cm), progression defined per RECIST 1.1.

nodal_progression_date.description: Date on which nodal progression per PCWG3 criteria was first documented.

nodal_progression_location.description: Location of progressive nodal disease, recorded separately per PCWG3 as locoregional versus metastatic.

visceral_progression_pcwg3.description: Indicates whether visceral progression per PCWG3/RECIST 1.1 criteria has been documented. Measurable visceral lesions ≥1.0 cm in longest dimension. Recorded separately by organ site.

visceral_progression_date.description: Date on which visceral progression was first documented.

visceral_progression_site.description: Organ site(s) of visceral progression, recorded separately per PCWG3.

bone_progression_pcwg3.description: Indicates whether bone progression per PCWG3 2+2 rule has been documented: ≥2 new lesions on first post-treatment scan, confirmed by ≥2 additional new lesions on the next scan. Date of progression = date of first post-treatment scan showing initial 2 new lesions.

bone_progression_date.description: Date of the first post-treatment scan on which ≥2 new bone lesions were initially documented per PCWG3 2+2 rule. This is the recorded date of progression even if confirmation occurs on a subsequent scan.

bone_progression_confirmed_date.description: Date of the confirmatory scan on which ≥2 additional new bone lesions were documented, fulfilling the PCWG3 2+2 rule.

bone_scan_flare.description: Indicates whether a bone scan flare was identified on the first post-treatment scan (new lesions on first follow-up scan not confirmed on subsequent scan) per PCWG3. Flare should not be recorded as progression.

bone_progression_criteria_used.description: Specifies the bone progression criteria applied. In ¹⁷⁷Lu-PSMA studies, PSMA-PET/CT or post-therapy SPECT/CT may serve as primary bone imaging modality rather than conventional 99mTc bone scintigraphy.

mixed_response.description: Indicates whether a mixed response was observed: simultaneous favorable change in one site and unfavorable change in another. Per PCWG3, the disease should be assessed as a whole rather than on the basis of index lesions alone.

mixed_response_sites.description: Description of sites showing divergent responses in cases of mixed response, specifying which site(s) responded and which progressed.

overall_treatment_response_category.description: Composite overall response integrating PSA response, radiographic response, and clinical status. Captures patients with discordant PSA/imaging responses, which are common in ¹⁷⁷Lu-PSMA RPT.

psa_imaging_concordance.description: Indicates concordance or discordance between PSA progression and radiographic progression at time of treatment discontinuation. Discordance (e.g., PSA rise with stable imaging) is clinically relevant in ¹⁷⁷Lu-PSMA RPT.

recip_response.description: Original response label from the source (CMR/PMR/SMD/PMD/NE); pair with criteria_name/version and canonical recip_category. Do not treat SUV change alone as RECIP response.

recip_response_date.description: Date of the PSMA-PET scan used for RECIP 1.0 response assessment.

psma_pet_response_date.description: Date of response under the explicitly named PET criteria. Uptake change alone does not establish RECIP response.

psma_pet_progression_date.description: Date of PET progression under the named criteria. RECIP-PD requires both the specified whole-body volume increase and new lesions; do not apply an OR rule.

psma_expression_change_percent.description: Percentage change in a prespecified PSMA PET uptake metric (for example SUVmax or SUVmean) for a defined lesion or lesion summary. Metric, lesion-selection rule, acquisition, and reconstruction method must be recorded.

new_psma_avid_lesions_posttreatment.description: Number of new PSMA-avid lesions identified on post-treatment PSMA-PET scan compared to baseline, regardless of anatomical site.

alp_response_normalization.description: Normalization to the institution-specific reference range, with applicability and laboratory evidence.

alp_response_date.description: Date on which ALP normalization was first documented.

alp_best_response_percent.description: Minimum signed 100 × (ALP at assessment − baseline ALP) / baseline ALP over the declared window when best response means greatest decline. Negative is decline. Specify selection rule; omit if baseline is zero.

ldh_response_normalization.description: Normalization to the institution-specific reference range, with applicability and laboratory evidence.

ldh_best_response_percent.description: Minimum signed 100 × (LDH at assessment − baseline LDH) / baseline LDH over the declared window when best response means greatest decline. Negative is decline. Specify selection rule; omit if baseline is zero.

hemoglobin_nadir_value.description: Lowest hemoglobin value recorded during ¹⁷⁷Lu-PSMA RPT. Associated with hematologic toxicity and independently prognostic for OS in mCRPC.

hemoglobin_nadir_date.description: Date on which the hemoglobin nadir was recorded.

ctc_conversion_favorable.description: Recorded assay-specific CTC conversion with baseline/follow-up evidence; not assessed is distinct from no.

testosterone_response.description: Serum testosterone level at end of treatment or last follow-up, relative to castrate threshold (≤50 ng/dL). Relevant for assessing adequacy of castration during therapy.

fdg_pet_positivity.description: Provisional field for FDG PET positivity; operational definition requires review.

invovled_organ_systems.description: Provisional field for invovled organ systems; operational definition requires review.

mri_pirads.description: Provisional field for MRI; PIRADS; operational definition requires review.
